200.html:
data [required]

[object]

List of devices matching the request.

attributes

object

Common health and identity attributes shared by every End User Device Monitoring device record.

agent_key

string

Public key of the Datadog Agent installed on the device.

agent_version

string

Version of the Datadog Agent installed on the device.

battery_critical

boolean

Whether the device's battery health has degraded to a critical level.

battery_max_capacity_pct

int64

Maximum battery capacity expressed as a percentage of the device's design capacity.

cpu_cores

int64

Number of physical CPU cores on the device.

cpu_logical_processors

int64

Number of logical CPU processors (hardware threads) on the device.

cpu_model

string

Human-readable name of the device's CPU model.

cpu_usage

double

Average CPU usage on the device, as a percentage between 0 and 100.

disk_usage

double

Average disk usage on the device, as a percentage between 0 and 100.

employee

object

Directory information about the employee associated with the device, sourced from a customer reference table. Absent when no reference table is configured or the device has no match.

city

string

City where the employee is based.

country

string

Country where the employee is based.

department

string

Department the employee belongs to.

email

string

Email address of the employee.

name

string

Full name of the employee.

office

string

Office the employee is assigned to.

team

string

Team the employee belongs to.

geo_ip

object

Location derived from the device's public IP address. Absent when no location data is available.

geo_city

string

City resolved from the device's public IP address.

geo_country_iso_code

string

ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code resolved from the device's public IP address.

geo_latitude

double

Latitude resolved from the device's public IP address.

geo_longitude

double

Longitude resolved from the device's public IP address.

geo_subdivision_iso_code

string

ISO 3166-2 subdivision code (for example, a state or province) resolved from the device's public IP address.

public_ip_address

string

Public IPv4 or IPv6 address of the device.

ip_address

string

Last observed IPv4 or IPv6 address of the device.

issues

[string]

List of issue identifiers currently affecting the device.

kernel_name

string

Name of the operating system kernel running on the device.

last_reboot

string

Timestamp of the most recent device reboot, in RFC 3339 format.

last_seen

string

Timestamp of the most recent telemetry received from the device, in RFC 3339 format.

manufacturer

string

Manufacturer of the device.

mem_usage

double

Average memory usage on the device, as a percentage between 0 and 100.

memory_total_kb

int64

Total amount of physical memory available on the device, in kilobytes.

model_name

string

Marketing or product name of the device model.

model_number

string

Manufacturer-assigned model number of the device.

os

string

Operating system family running on the device, as reported by the Datadog Agent (for example, macOS, Windows, or linux). Empty when unknown.

os_version

string

Operating system version running on the device.

resource_id

string

Datadog resource identifier for the device.

serial_number

string

Serial number assigned to the device by its manufacturer.

status

enum

Health status of the device, computed from its issues and recent telemetry. inactive means the device stopped reporting. unknown means no telemetry is available yet. Allowed enum values: healthy,degraded,critical,inactive,unknown

type

string

Hardware type of the device (for example, laptop or desktop). unknown when the type cannot be determined.

uptime

double

Time elapsed since the device last booted, in seconds.

wlan_bssid

string

BSSID (MAC address of the access point) of the wireless network the device is currently connected to.

wlan_rssi

double

Received signal strength indicator of the device's current wireless connection, in dBm.

wlan_ssid

string

SSID of the wireless network the device is currently connected to.

id [required]

string

Unique identifier of the device. Matches the Datadog host identifier.

type [required]

enum

Devices resource type. Allowed enum values: devices

default: devices

links

object

Links related to the current page of devices.

next

string

URL of the next page of devices. Present only when more devices remain.

self

string

URL of the current request.

meta

object

Metadata about the list devices response.

page

object

Pagination information for the list devices response.

after

string

Cursor to pass as page[cursor] to get the next page. Present only when more devices remain.

400.html:
errors [required]

[object]

A list of errors.

detail

string

A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the error.

meta

object

Non-standard meta-information about the error

source

object

References to the source of the error.

header

string

A string indicating the name of a single request header which caused the error.

parameter

string

A string indicating which URI query parameter caused the error.

pointer

string

A JSON pointer to the value in the request document that caused the error.

status

string

Status code of the response.

title

string

Short human-readable summary of the error.

429.html:
errors [required]

[string]

A list of errors.

200.html:
data

object

A single device entry with full attribute detail.

attributes

object

Extended set of attributes for a single End User Device Monitoring device, including Cloud Network Monitoring and battery metrics.

agent_key

string

Public key of the Datadog Agent installed on the device.

agent_version

string

Version of the Datadog Agent installed on the device.

battery_charge_pct

int64

Current battery charge level as a percentage between 0 and 100.

battery_charge_rate

int64

Rate at which the battery is charging or discharging, in milliamperes. Negative values indicate discharge.

battery_critical

boolean

Whether the device's battery health has degraded to a critical level.

battery_cycle_count

int64

Number of full charge cycles the battery has gone through.

battery_max_capacity_pct

int64

Maximum battery capacity expressed as a percentage of the device's design capacity.

cnm_enabled

boolean

Whether Cloud Network Monitoring is enabled on the device.

cpu_cores

int64

Number of physical CPU cores on the device.

cpu_logical_processors

int64

Number of logical CPU processors (hardware threads) on the device.

cpu_model

string

Human-readable name of the device's CPU model.

cpu_usage

double

Average CPU usage on the device, as a percentage between 0 and 100.

disk_usage

double

Average disk usage on the device, as a percentage between 0 and 100.

Last observed IPv4 or IPv6 address of the device.

[string]

model_name

model_number

Manufacturer-assigned model number of the device.

os

string

Operating system family running on the device, as reported by the Datadog Agent (for example, macOS, Windows, or linux). Empty when unknown.

os_version

string

Operating system version running on the device.

packet_sent

double

Number of TCP packets sent by the device over the query window, as reported by Cloud Network Monitoring.

resource_id

string

Datadog resource identifier for the device.

retransmit

double

Number of TCP packets retransmitted by the device over the query window.

retransmit_pct

double

Percentage of sent TCP packets that were retransmitted, between 0 and 100.

serial_number

string

Serial number assigned to the device by its manufacturer.

status

enum

Health status of the device, computed from its issues and recent telemetry. inactive means the device stopped reporting. unknown means no telemetry is available yet. Allowed enum values: healthy,degraded,critical,inactive,unknown

tcp_canceled

double

Number of TCP connection attempts canceled by the device over the query window.

tcp_established

double

Number of TCP connections established by the device over the query window.

tcp_establishment_failure_pct

double

Percentage of TCP connection attempts that failed, between 0 and 100.

tcp_establishment_failures

double

Number of TCP connection attempts that failed over the query window.

tcp_host_unreachable

double

Number of TCP connection attempts that failed because the host was unreachable.

tcp_network_unreachable

double

Number of TCP connection attempts that failed because the network was unreachable.

tcp_refusals

double

Number of TCP connection attempts refused by the remote host over the query window.

tcp_timeouts

double

Number of TCP connection attempts that timed out over the query window.

type

string

Hardware type of the device (for example, laptop or desktop). unknown when the type cannot be determined.

uptime

double

Time elapsed since the device last booted, in seconds.

string

BSSID (MAC address of the access point) of the wireless network the device is currently connected to.

double

string
